entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac. I'm calling about an order I received a couple of months back. I'd like to return a cycling jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's a preference, I guess. It turned out to be the wrong size for me. I ordered my usual large, but this particular model is just too tight across the chest.
I understand completely, getting the right fit is key. Do you have the order number handy?
Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Vent Pro jersey, delivered on November 15th, 2025. That makes it 61 days ago. Is that correct?
Yes, that's the one. I was hoping to do an exchange for the next size up.

Let me just confirm the policy for that item... And yes, great news. Standard apparel like that jersey has a 90-day return window. You're well within that period, so we can absolutely process an exchange for you.

Excellent, that's great to hear. I appreciate you making that easy. Now, since I am a VIP member and have to go through the hassle of shipping this back, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase?

I can see you're one of our top customers, and we certainly value your business. For the trouble, I'd be happy to offer you a 15% off coupon code that you can use on your next order. How does that sound?
That sounds perfect. A 15% discount works for me. Thank you, Isaac.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the exchange and sent a pre-paid return label to your email. Once our warehouse receives the original jersey, we'll dispatch the larger size to you immediately. Your coupon code is VIP-SAVE15. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
